finding: audit 2026-10-03 (HANDOFF.md): historical goalie inputs used a postgame fact

sources.reason: Registered on stage-2 evidence that gave the model each game's actual starting goalie, a fact known only after the start (candidates/goalies.py actual_starters; no pregame goalie listing exists before 2026-10-01). The evidence does not show a pregame gain, so the source is not selectable. Forecasts keep being recorded with pregame listings; eligibility needs new evidence that uses only listings retrieved before the start.
